name: 68116 · Omaha, NE
findings: ZIP 68116 (Omaha) has 88 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 68116 (Omaha) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 68116 (Omaha) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 37 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.
